newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: CRICKET-PAKISTAN PUT IN NEW ZEALAND IN SECOND TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN PUT IN NEW ZEALAND IN SECOND TEST.

text.p: Pakistan won the toss and put New Zealand in to bat at the start of the second cricket test on Thursday.

The major ommission from Pakistan team was paceman Waqar Younis. The fast bowler, who has taken 200 test wickets, sustained side-strain during the first test at Lahore nad has been replaced by Mohammad Akram.
Mohammad Zahid, a right-arm fast-medium bowler makes his test debut at the expense of Saqlain Mushtaq.
New Zealand made no changes in their side that won the first test in Lahore.
New Zealand - Bryan Young, Justin Vaughan, Adam Parore, Stephen Fleming, Nathan Astle, Mark Greatbatch, Chris Cairns, Chris Harris, Lee Germon (captain), Dipak Patel, Simon Doull.
Pakistan - Saeed Anwar (captain), Zahoor Elahi, Inzamam-ul-Haq, Ejaz Ahmed, Salim Malik, Mohammad Wasim, Moin Khan, Mushtaq Ahmed, Mohammad Zahid, Shaid Nazir, Mohammad Akram.
Umpires - Lloyd Barker (West Indies), Javed Akhtar (Pakistan).
